micro_business.title: Home-Kitchen Tiffin or Meal-Prep Service
micro_business.description: You already plan, cook, and time meals for your household every day. That same skill is the core of a home-based tiffin service or small batch meal-prep business for working professionals nearby.
micro_business.step_one: Step 1: Pick 2 dishes you already cook well and ask 3 neighbors or coworkers if they'd pay for a weekly tiffin of just those two.

market_enquiry.prompt: Ask nearby cooks or tiffin services what they charge per hour or per meal.

micro_business.title: Weekly Home Organizing / Cleaning Micro-Service
micro_business.description: You've built a system for keeping a home running smoothly. That organizational eye is exactly what busy households pay outside help for.
micro_business.step_one: Step 1: Offer a single paid 2-hour deep-clean or declutter session to one household in your building or society this month.

market_enquiry.prompt: Ask local cleaners what a 2-hour visit costs in your area.

micro_business.title: Neighborhood Laundry & Ironing Pickup Service
micro_business.description: Laundry management -- sorting, washing, ironing, folding -- is a service busy families and bachelors regularly pay for nearby.
micro_business.step_one: Step 1: Ask 2 neighbors if they'd pay a flat weekly rate for you to wash and iron a fixed number of clothing items.

market_enquiry.prompt: Ask nearby laundry shops or pickup services for a weekly bundle rate.

micro_business.title: Errand & Grocery-Run Concierge
micro_business.description: You already manage household logistics efficiently. Elderly neighbors and busy professionals often pay for a trusted local person to handle errands.
micro_business.step_one: Step 1: Offer to run one weekly errand (grocery pickup or bill payment) for an elderly neighbor for a small flat fee.

market_enquiry.prompt: Ask local helpers or concierge listings what a grocery or errand run costs.

micro_business.title: After-School Homework Tutoring Circle
micro_business.description: Helping with homework daily has sharpened real teaching skills. Small tutoring groups for a subject you're confident in are in steady local demand.
micro_business.step_one: Step 1: Offer a one-hour homework help session for 2-3 kids in your building for one subject you're strongest in.

market_enquiry.prompt: Ask local tutors what they charge for one hour of homework help nearby.

micro_business.title: Trusted Neighborhood Childcare Co-op or After-School Watch
micro_business.description: You're already skilled at feeding, entertaining, and safely supervising children. Other parents nearby need exactly this kind of trusted help during specific hours.
micro_business.step_one: Step 1: Offer to watch one neighbor's child for 2 hours after school on a single day and see how it goes.

market_enquiry.prompt: Ask nearby nannies or after-school sitters what a 2-hour session costs.

micro_business.title: Elder Companion & Care-Coordination Service
micro_business.description: You already manage medicines, appointments, and daily support for an elder. Many families need trained, trustworthy help doing exactly this for their own parents.
micro_business.step_one: Step 1: Offer to companion-sit or handle one doctor visit for an elderly neighbor this month.

market_enquiry.prompt: Ask local attendants or companion-care listings for a half-day or visit rate.
